profile.headline: Software Engineer at Affirm
profile.summary: I love to create.  Software engineering gives me that power.  The bulk of my experience is in Ruby on Rails, Javascript, and React.  I've also worked on applications in Clojure and Go, and dabbled in Python.  Check out the snapshots of projects I've worked on (below this description) and read more details in the "Experience" and "Accomplishments" sections.

positions.title: Attorney-Analyst, contractor at Department of Justice, Consumer Protection Branch
positions.description:
•     Analyzed 100,000s of documents in investigations of pharmaceutical companies
•     Served as legal team’s resident expert on the facts of a multi-year medical device investigation, fielding technical questions relevant to legal arguments and liaising with expert witness
•     Formed investigative strategies, interviewed witnesses, and prepared presentations of evidence and legal theories for management and opposing counsel

projects.title: Kindred
projects.description:
Video chat application that pairs strangers from diverse backgrounds to discuss a question of the day
https://github.com/nzey/kindred

- Collaborated with team of four to design clean, responsive frontend with Javascript, React, D3, and CSS3 flexbox
- Incorporated Redux to manage data flow and formatting, reducing  time-intensive database calls
- Architected backend with Go, PostgreSQL, Node, Redis and Firebase to optimize performance and scalability, avoid repetitive database calls, and host realtime chat
- Connected robust SQL schema with RESTful API to serve a variety of data formats required by application’s primary functionality, data analysis, and feedback systems
- Set-up secure deployment environment on AWS EC2 instance hosting Go, Node, PostgreSQL, and Redis servers

projects.title: Snazr
projects.description:
Snazr, Location based application for crowdsourced candid photos 

- Redesigned API to persist data between MongoDB, Express, and React Native for features such as flagging and blocking abusive users
- Added React Native component to render selection view for deleting or flagging multiple photos simultaneously
